name: mercado-publico-kit
description: Kit completo para trabajar con la API de Mercado Público (ChileCompra): SDK, backend seguro y app web/móvil.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mp/sdk && npm run build -w @mp/api && npm run build -w @mp/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mp/sdk && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @mp/api" "npm run dev -w @mp/web"
scripts.dev:mock: npm run build -w @mp/sdk && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:mock -w @mp/api" "npm run dev -w @mp/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mp/sdk && npm run test -w @mp/api
